column1: # CANONICAL sequences for the 12 depth-arm designs, 2026-10-09.
# Source: the seed-1 fold of the 5-seed human replication -- i.e. the molecule the
# REPORTED margin is for. Written because several design ids carry TWO DISTINCT
# sequences across the depth arm rounds (an aborted round-2 run left a parallel
# depthB2/depthB2v2 tree), and a first-match glob therefore selected different
# molecules for different analyses: 3 of 12 sequence-based screens were run on a
# sequence at 0.446-0.663 identity to the one actually scored. Verified: all 12
# replication folds match one of their own design's depthB folds at identity 1.000,
# so the margins stand; only the sequence-derived screens needed re-running.
